messages:
oliver_release: Heads-up — I'm putting release r-2026-03-20-007 on hold. EU DB just did a failover and canary is showing elevated errors.
opsbot: Incident INC-2026-105 created: EU primary DB failover at 2026-03-20T09:12Z. Autoscaling triggered.
deploybot: HOLD applied by @oliver_release — release r-2026-03-20-007 (canary 10%) paused.
mike_sre: Seeing KV cache miss storms + spike in 5xxs for canary shard eu-1, error rate ~3.2% over last 6m.
lia_product: Do we prefer rollback the canary or keep it paused and drain?
jess: Pause + drain. Rolling back risks masking infra issue. set canary -> 0 and requeue release to next window. :+1:
oliver_release: Agreed. We won't unpin the model version; keep the release candidate tagged but not promoted. I'll update the release notes to mark as "hold due to infra incident".
mike_sre: Command to set canary to zero: `/deploybot set-canary r-2026-03-20-007 0 --reason "INC-2026-105 kv cache surge"`
deploybot: Ack — canary for r-2026-03-20-007 set to 0 by @mike_sre.
sara_oncall: Adding that the DB team is running async replication catch-up. ETA ~2h but could be sooner. Will post updates in INC-2026-105.
lia_product: Proposed reschedule: move to change window 2026-03-20 18:00 UTC and run a smaller canary (5%) with synthetic traffic first. Anyone object?
mike_sre: Fine with that. We'll run kv-cache warmers and a short smoke test before canary spike. Add a manual gate for retry.
jess: Also add a rollback play in the release notes and pin a fallback model variant in the routing policy in case of model-serving regressions.
oliver_release: I'll update the release PR: add a section "Hold: DB failover" with links to INC-2026-105 and the rollback checklist. Also I will create a follow-up task to re-run perf perf-eval against eu-1 after infra stabilizes.
mike_sre: For clarity, the rollout plan when we resume: 5% canary -> 30% after 10m stable -> 100% after 30m stable. Abort on error rate >1% OR latency 95p > 400ms.
jess: We'll notify customers in release notes slack channel and update changelog on the web UI.
sara_oncall: I'll keep the incident updates rolling here. If DB team confirms catch-up <45m, we can consider an earlier retry in the 14:00 UTC window.
lia_product: OK — reschedule tentative for 18:00 UTC and I'll set calendar invite with ops/responsibles.
oliver_release: One more: tag the PR with `hold/INC-2026-105` and don't merge any hotfixes into the release branch without a direct heads-up.
mike_sre: Noted. I'll also add a temporary circuit-breaker rule for eu-1 to force fallback to eu-2 for non-sensitive calls while we stabilize.
jess: Thanks. Once the incident is closed, we'll re-evaluate whether to proceed or cancel and roll the change into next weekly release.
deploybot: Release r-2026-03-20-007 state: PAUSED (canary=0). Next scheduled attempt: 2026-03-20T18:00:00Z (tentative). Operator: @oliver_release.
opsbot: Reminder: link to postmortem template -> https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-105. Please add any timeline notes.
oliver_release: I'll draft the note. Thanks everyone — I'll ping this thread when I unhold or if we move earlier. :wave:
